targets.rawSql:
WITH time_bounds AS (
  SELECT 
    $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS range_start,
    $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS range_end
),
time_grid AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from b.range_start) / extract(epoch from GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', ('$__interval')::interval))) * extract(epoch from GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', ('$__interval')::interval)))::timestamptz,
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from b.range_end) / extract(epoch from GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', ('$__interval')::interval))) * extract(epoch from GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', ('$__interval')::interval)))::timestamptz,
    GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', ('$__interval')::interval)
  ) AS grid_time
  FROM time_bounds b
),
aggregated_data AS (
  SELECT 
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from timestamp) / extract(epoch from GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', ('$__interval')::interval))) * extract(epoch from GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', ('$__interval')::interval)))::timestamptz AS bucket_time,
    AVG(cpu_package_temp) AS cpu_temp, AVG(cpu_package_power) AS cpu_power
  FROM public.fact_system_hardware
  WHERE timestamp >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
    AND timestamp <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 
  g.grid_time AS "time",
  ad.cpu_temp AS "CPU 封装温度", ad.cpu_power AS "CPU 封装功率"
FROM time_grid g
LEFT JOIN aggregated_data ad ON ad.bucket_time = g.grid_time
ORDER BY 1;

panels.description: 基于每进程活动数据积分估算的整机累计数据交换总量。采样校准因子 3.1 秒。

targets.rawSql:
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(proc_disk_read_rate_mb * 1048576.0 * 3.1) AS r,
    SUM(proc_disk_write_rate_mb * 1048576.0 * 3.1) AS w,
    SUM(proc_network_send_kb * 1024.0 * 3.1) AS s,
    SUM(proc_network_recv_kb * 1024.0 * 3.1) AS recv
  FROM public.fact_process_activity
  WHERE timestamp >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
    AND timestamp <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
)
SELECT '累计磁盘读取' AS metric, r AS value FROM agg
UNION ALL
SELECT '累计磁盘写入' AS metric, w AS value FROM agg
UNION ALL
SELECT '累计网络上传' AS metric, s AS value FROM agg
UNION ALL
SELECT '累计网络下载' AS metric, recv AS value FROM agg;

    $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS range_end
),
time_grid AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from b.range_start) / extract(epoch from GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', ('$__interval')::interval))) * extract(epoch from GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', ('$__interval')::interval)))::timestamptz,
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from b.range_end) / extract(epoch from GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', ('$__interval')::interval))) * extract(epoch from GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', ('$__interval')::interval)))::timestamptz,
    GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', ('$__interval')::interval)
  ) AS grid_time
  FROM time_bounds b
),
aggregated_data AS (
  SELECT 
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from timestamp) / extract(epoch from GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', ('$__interval')::interval))) * extract(epoch from GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', ('$__interval')::interval)))::timestamptz AS bucket_time,
    SUM(proc_vram_used_gb) AS vram
  FROM public.fact_process_activity
  WHERE timestamp >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
    AND timestamp <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 
  g.grid_time AS "time",
  ad.vram * 1073741824.0 AS "显存占用"
FROM time_grid g
LEFT JOIN aggregated_data ad ON ad.bucket_time = g.grid_time
ORDER BY 1;

WITH time_bounds AS (
  SELECT 
    $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS range_start,
    $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS range_end
),
time_grid AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from b.range_start) / extract(epoch from GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', ('$__interval')::interval))) * extract(epoch from GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', ('$__interval')::interval)))::timestamptz,
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from b.range_end) / extract(epoch from GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', ('$__interval')::interval))) * extract(epoch from GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', ('$__interval')::interval)))::timestamptz,
    GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', ('$__interval')::interval)
  ) AS grid_time
  FROM time_bounds b
),
aggregated_data AS (
  SELECT 
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from timestamp) / extract(epoch from GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', ('$__interval')::interval))) * extract(epoch from GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', ('$__interval')::interval)))::timestamptz AS bucket_time,
    SUM(proc_network_send_kb) AS send_kb, SUM(proc_network_recv_kb) AS recv_kb
  FROM public.fact_process_activity
  WHERE timestamp >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
    AND timestamp <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 
  g.grid_time AS "time",
  ad.send_kb * 1024.0 AS "网络发送速度", ad.recv_kb * 1024.0 AS "网络接收速度"
FROM time_grid g
LEFT JOIN aggregated_data ad ON ad.bucket_time = g.grid_time
ORDER BY 1;

WITH daily_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    timestamp,
    date_trunc('$aging_step', timestamp) AS period,
    gpu_board_power,
    gpu_core_temp,
    gpu_hotspot_temp,
    gpu_core_clock,
    gpu_core_voltage,
    MAX(gpu_board_power) OVER(PARTITION BY date_trunc('$aging_step', timestamp)) AS max_gpu_pwr
  FROM public.fact_system_hardware
  WHERE timestamp >= now() - interval '$aging_window'
    AND timestamp <= now()
)
SELECT 
  period AS "time",
  AVG(CASE WHEN max_gpu_pwr > ${gpu_min_watt} AND gpu_board_power >= ${aging_load_ratio} * max_gpu_pwr THEN gpu_core_temp ELSE NULL END) AS "GPU 核心负载温度",
  AVG(CASE WHEN max_gpu_pwr > ${gpu_min_watt} AND gpu_board_power >= ${aging_load_ratio} * max_gpu_pwr THEN gpu_hotspot_temp ELSE NULL END) AS "GPU 热点负载温度",
  AVG(CASE WHEN max_gpu_pwr > ${gpu_min_watt} AND gpu_board_power >= ${aging_load_ratio} * max_gpu_pwr THEN gpu_board_power ELSE NULL END) AS "GPU 负载功率",
  AVG(CASE WHEN max_gpu_pwr > ${gpu_min_watt} AND gpu_board_power >= ${aging_load_ratio} * max_gpu_pwr THEN gpu_core_clock ELSE NULL END) AS "GPU 负载时钟",
  AVG(CASE WHEN max_gpu_pwr > ${gpu_min_watt} AND gpu_board_power >= ${aging_load_ratio} * max_gpu_pwr THEN gpu_core_voltage ELSE NULL END) AS "GPU 负载电压"
FROM daily_metrics
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

WITH partition_stats AS (
  SELECT
    'time_audit (当前数据库)' AS name,
    pg_database_size('time_audit') AS size_bytes,
    (SELECT SUM(reltuples)::bigint FROM pg_class WHERE relkind = 'r' AND (relname LIKE 'fact_%' OR relname = 'app_usage_logs')) AS est_rows,
    '📁 数据库级' AS level_type
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    child.relname AS name,
    pg_total_relation_size(child.oid) AS size_bytes,
    child.reltuples::bigint AS est_rows,
    CASE 
      WHEN parent.relname = 'fact_process_activity' THEN '⚡ 进程活跃度分表 (按周)'
      WHEN parent.relname = 'fact_process_context' THEN '🪟 前台聚焦分表 (按周)'
      WHEN parent.relname = 'fact_system_hardware' THEN '💻 整机硬件分表 (按月)'
      ELSE '📦 其他子分区'
    END AS level_type
  FROM pg_inherits
  JOIN pg_class parent ON pg_inherits.inhparent = parent.oid
  JOIN pg_class child ON pg_inherits.inhrelid = child.oid
  WHERE parent.relname IN ('fact_process_activity', 'fact_process_context', 'fact_system_hardware')
)
SELECT
  name AS "数据表/分区",
  pg_size_pretty(size_bytes) AS "占用物理空间",
  CASE WHEN est_rows < 0 THEN 0 ELSE est_rows END AS "记录行数 (估算)",
  level_type AS "层级 / 类别"
FROM partition_stats
ORDER BY size_bytes DESC;
